name: Ability Loadout
description: Selects which unlocked active abilities occupy a character's limited hotbar slots. The skill tree owns ranks and Hotbar Abilities owns execution; this owns only assignment, named presets, and pruning when a source rank disappears. Catalog entries point back to a source node and minimum rank rather than duplicating progression rules. Assignment publishes one complete loadout snapshot so Hotbar never combines a stale manual kit with the new selection.

implementations.note: Implemented in the consuming application; not verifiable from this repository.

inputs.name: slots
inputs.description: Number of active slots. This is a selection cap, not a cooldown or cast rule.

inputs.name: abilityCatalog
inputs.description: Active definitions: [{id, sourceNodeId, minRank?, allowedSlots?, ability?}]. minRank defaults to 1; ability is the execution data forwarded to Hotbar. Empty means the host has supplied no actives.

inputs.name: initialLoadout
inputs.description: Restored ability ids or nulls in slot order. Entries whose source rank is no longer present are pruned rather than allowed to cast from a stale build.

inputs.name: presets
inputs.description: Named loadout arrays. Applying one is an all-or-nothing assignment after every entry is validated.

inputs.name: allowDuplicateAbilities
inputs.description: Whether one ability may occupy multiple slots. False keeps scarce actives from bypassing the intended loadout choice.

outputs.name: loadout
outputs.description: Ability ids or nulls in slot order.

outputs.name: availableAbilities
outputs.description: Catalog abilities whose source node currently meets minRank.

outputs.name: boundAbilities
outputs.description: Ordered execution records derived from the current slots and catalog, ready for Hotbar binding.

outputs.name: presetNames
outputs.description: Named presets available to the host UI.

provenance: RPG buildcraft pass on 2026-11-02 searched Skills Tree, Hotbar Abilities, Weapon Loadout, Style Presets, Prepared Spellbook and Equipment Slots. Skills Tree owns passive unlocks, Hotbar owns cast execution, Weapon Loadout owns weapons, and the other systems own unrelated preparation or presentation state. No contract owned assigning unlocked active abilities to limited slots or pruning them after respec, so this adds that boundary without moving cooldowns or damage into progression.
